description: Create feature branch and set up environment - install all dependencies and verify existing builds pass
steps: Create a new branch named 'feat/seo-geo-aeo-optimization' from the current branch (fix/p0-issues-and-workflow-updates-v2)
Run corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate to set up pnpm
Run pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile at the repo root to install all Node dependencies
Run pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit to verify edge worker compiles
Install Python dependencies: pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt (strip hashes first with sed)
Run pytest apps/backend/ --tb=short -q to verify backend tests pass
Run pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test to verify edge tests pass
acceptance_criteria: New branch 'feat/seo-geo-aeo-optimization' exists and is checked out
Edge worker TypeScript compiles without errors
verification: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit exits with code 0
pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test exits with code 0
findings: 1. Pre-existing TypeScript error in apps/edge/src/middleware/bot.ts: response.json() returns 'unknown' in strict mode. Fixed with type assertion. 2. requirements.txt has pytest-asyncio==1.0.0 which conflicts with pytest==9.0.3 (requires pytest<9). Worked around by installing pytest-asyncio separately (resolved to compatible 1.3.0). 3. Backend tests test_auth.py, test_chat.py, test_webhook.py all ERROR due to missing Azure credentials (AzureKeyCredential expects string key). These are pre-existing and not caused by our changes. 23 isolated tests (test_security.py, test_circuit_breaker.py) pass. 4. Edge vitest runs in watch mode by default; use 'vitest run' for CI. 5. pnpm install shows ignored build scripts warning (esbuild, workerd, sharp) but this is normal.
